commands: git status && git branch -a && git log --oneline -5

starbridge ask \
  --question 'Which settings-screen variant should I ship by merging into main?' \
  --context 'Both variants pass the tests; shipping merges the picked branch into main.
Compact (settings-compact): tighter rows, 9 settings per screen (fits Language, Shortcuts, About without scrolling).
Roomy (settings-roomy): taller rows, 6 settings per screen, more whitespace — remaining items need scrolling.' \
  --option 'Compact' --option 'Roomy' \
  --image shots/compact.png --image shots/roomy.png \
  --waiting
turns.final: The choice between visual designs is the owner's, so I'll ask via starbridge.

decisions.question: Which settings-screen variant should I ship by merging into main?
